verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled or triggered workflows or rules that act without a human. Autotune's automatic explore/exploit allocation is a specific bandit-experiment feature, not general automations. The Console API and MCP server are developer building blocks someone could use to construct automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
